messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the quant/batching/cache recommendations pilot. Customer A wants advice within 2 weeks. I sketched a minimal MLP: batching heuristics + per-customer quant suggestions + eval-triggered alerts. Thoughts?
Sam: Can we be explicit about what 'recommendation' means? a) config suggestion (batch size, max latency) b) quant profile (int8/4) c) rollout plan. I assume (a)+(b) for pilot.
Jordan: Agree on (a)+(b). Launch criteria: 1) recommendations validated on 3 internal workloads with >5% cost reduction 2) no >2x P95 latency regressions 3) docs + quickstart.
Lia: For eval-triggered alerts: we should tie to eval suite that includes hallucination/basic coherence checks. If a model change causes eval delta > threshold, send alert to owners and optionally disable auto-apply.
Alex: From runtime side — quant recs require metadata: model family, seq len distribution, target latency SLO. We can compute expected perf delta via benchmark table. Quick sample config we can emit:```json
{"customer_id":"cust-A","model":"mistral-1-7b","seq_p50":128,"target_p95_ms":350,"recommended": {"batch_size":8,"quant":"int8","notes":"use static 8-bit w/ per-channel"}}
```
Sam: Nice. Where does caching recs fit? prefix caching should be separate rule set (when >30% token reuse). Maybe the advisor returns: cache=yes/size.
Maya: Pilot scope proposal: MVP = (1) batching heuristics + UI suggestions (inline) (2) quant recommendations w/ confidence score (3) eval-alert plumbing (alerts to slack + email, no auto-apply). No per-cust autoscaling changes.
Jordan: Risk check: need safety net on quant recs — QA run that verifies output tokens/likelihood distribution doesn't drop beyond delta threshold. Add that to launch criteria.
Lia: Also add observability: token-level cost estimate + how we computed gain. Customers will ask for rationale.
Alex: Implementation note: estimator will run offline job that samples 1k prompts per customer and runs quantized perf simulation. Runtime impact minimal. Ops-bot: Scheduled job created: optimize-advisor-sim v1 — runs daily at 03:00 UTC for pilot (owner: @Alex).
Maya: OK — next steps: Sam/Jordan draft product spec w/ acceptance tests, Alex to prototype simulator, Lia to wire eval hooks. Sync Thurs 10am. :thumbsup:
